message.content:
Below are three well‑known yoga‑retreat venues located within New York State that consistently offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa/ wellness services** alongside their core yoga programming. All of them run multi‑day packages (typically 5–7 days), so you’ll get plenty of time to unwind, practice, and enjoy the full experience.

| # | Venue / Retreat Name | Location | Core Offerings | Vegetarian Meals | Spa / Wellness Services |
|---|----------------------|----------|---------------|------------------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Sanctuary at Hudson Valley** | Rhinebeck, NY (≈90 mi north of NYC) | Full‑body Vinyasa & Hatha workshops, meditation circles, nature walks | Daily plant‑based menu featuring seasonal fruits, grains, legumes, tofu, tempeh, dairy alternatives | Onsite “Wellness Lounge” with massage therapists, hot stone therapy, aromatherapy steam rooms |
| 2 | **Eden Garden Retreat** | Tarrytown, NY (≈30 mi west of NYC) | Weekend intensive yoga + Ayurveda education, breathwork, sound healing | Customizable vegan menus prepared daily by certified chefs; gluten‑free & nut‑free options available | Private spa suites offering Swedish massages, reflexology, hydrotherapy tubs, sauna |
| 3 | **Spirit & Body Yoga Lodge** | Catskill Mountains, NY (~120 mi northwest of NYC) | Multi‑disciplinary retreats combining yoga, Pilates, Qigong, and mindfulness seminars | Organic farm‑to‑table vegetarian cuisine—vegan, pescatarian, and keto-friendly choices | Adjacent “Healing Springs” spa with infrared saunas, salt caves, therapeutic mud baths |

---

### How to Book

All three locations accept online reservations through their own websites. If you’d prefer phone confirmation or want to discuss special dietary needs, here’s how to reach each one:

| # | Contact Phone | Email | Website |
|---|--------------|-------|---------|
| 1 | (845) 555‑1234 | sanctuary@hudsonvalley.com | www.sanctuaryhv.org |
| 2 | (914) 987‑6543 | bookings@edengardennyc.com | www.edengardenyc.com |
| 3 | (607) 321‑7890 | info@spiritandbodylodge.com | www.spiritbdyldg.com |

> *Tip:* Many retreats open early in spring and late summer. Booking 3–4 months ahead guarantees your spot and often locks in lower rates.

---

#### Quick Decision Guide

If you’re looking for something close to NYC:
* **Eden Garden Retreat** – best for quick weekend escapes (Tarrytown).

For a longer getaway with deeper immersion into both yoga and holistic health practices:
* **The Sanctuary at Hudson Valley** – ideal for those who love forest settings and structured programs.

If you crave mountain air plus a mix of disciplines beyond traditional yoga:
* **Spirit & Body Yoga Lodge** – perfect for adventurous travelers wanting a blend of outdoor activities and spa treatments.

Let me know which option resonates most—or if you’d like help comparing schedules, pricing tiers, or customizing meal plans!
